pageTitle: Lernfino — Learn German from A1 to B2 with Fino
suggestion: This page is available in your browser language.
featuresIntro: Build all four German skills, then put them to work in exam practice and everyday situations.
heroAccent: From your first Hallo to B2.
heroIntro: Follow a German learning path from your first words to B2. Practice with mini lessons, everyday dialogues and full mock exams.
pathText: Begin with Starter S1–S10, then follow the path through A1 to B2 with short lessons you can fit into your day.
examsText: Take eight independent full mock exams in Goethe and ÖSD formats. Practice Hören and Lesen separately, with telc-format exercise sets also available.
aiText: Get optional AI feedback on spoken and written answers. Evaluation requires consent and is subject to account and plan limits.
lifeText: Practice 28 everyday scenarios, from finding an apartment to visiting a doctor. Read the dialogues, do exercises and take a speaking turn in role-play.
readingText: Read and listen to leveled stories. Look up words in context, then save them to My words.
reviewText: Use the mistake notebook to revisit errors and spaced repetition to practice words. Switch to dark mode whenever you like.
step1Text: Start from scratch or take the web placement test to see where to begin.
step2Text: Follow the learning path and practice a little at a time.
step3Text: Try a real-life dialogue, review words or work through a timed mock exam.
demoIntro: Choose a level, listen to an example sentence and tap a German word to see its meaning in context.
levelTestText: Answer up to 12 questions to estimate your German level from A1 to B2.
calculatorText: Enter your module scores and check them against the supported Goethe or ÖSD rules.
discount: Join the list for a special discount on your first subscription. The rate, duration and redemption details will be announced here and by email before launch.
limits: The free plan has daily usage limits. Access and AI evaluation allowances vary by plan.
consent: I agree to receive emails about the launch, product updates and the launch discount. I can unsubscribe at any time.
